note: a card that comes back from exile or the discard pile feeds a sacrifice outlet again (loops)
paying or losing your own life fires effects that reward losing life
pushing, pulling or tossing units puts them next to others, which sets up anything that needs neighbours
moving a unit puts it next to others, which sets up anything that needs neighbours
a summoned unit is put on a chosen space next to others, which sets up anything that needs neighbours
moving units into the line or shape an attack covers lets one attack hit more of them
swapping a unit into a tile with an effect puts it under that effect
more damage on the next attack makes the kill that triggers the effect more likely
